guidance: No usable laptop-to-laptop link. This machine has NO Thunderbolt/USB4 controller, and a plain USB-C to USB-C cable cannot connect two hosts (USB is host-to-device; neither laptop will act as a device). Use a USB-to-Ethernet adapter + Ethernet cable (preferred), OR a phone hotspot joining both laptops (test it once before the day - venue/enterprise Wi-Fi often isolates clients).
